name: mahbere-ahaw-lms
description: Mahbere Ahaw Seminary Distance Learning Management System

scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.render:build:api: npm install --include=dev && npm run prisma:generate -w @lms/api && npm run build:api && npm run prisma:compile-seed -w @lms/api
scripts.render:start:api: node ./scripts/render-preflight.mjs && npm run prisma:deploy -w @lms/api && npm run start:prod -w @lms/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lms/api && npm run lint -w @lms/web
